# CAD-Recode validation census and reach curve

Generated by `uv run arris-gym census --corpus cadrecode --out DIR` from the
original [CAD-Recode corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/filapro/cad-recode/tree/17d554bbc50a23de6cf6a742a3e0ed867f000153/val),
revision `17d554bbc50a23de6cf6a742a3e0ed867f000153`, validation only. The pin
contains 968 Python files (the dataset card says approximately 1k). All 968
parse and end in `r = …`. Their family is recorded as `validation` because
the source has no family labels. No source programs are committed.

`programs.jsonl.gz` holds canonical JSON lines in stem order: program SHA-256,
family, census outcome, source, config, revision and licence. Gzip has
`mtime=0`. Every row carries **CC-BY-NC-4.0**. `census.json` holds the
aggregate counts; `reach.json` the curve with the unchanged C1 subset.
Its initial reach is **0/968**: the end form is outside the subset. The curve
admits `r = …` first, then its sketch forms in the order the programs share
them: 299/968 after 14 items, 697 after 15, all 968 after 18. `manifest.json` records the uncompressed rows' SHA-256
and the validated census and reach digests. Two complete runs give equal
bytes and digests.

These counts, stems and hashes are adapted from CAD-Recode by Danila
Rukhovich, Elona Dupont, Dimitrios Mallis, Kseniya Cherenkova, Anis Kacem and
Djamila Aouada, [CAD-Recode: Reverse Engineering CAD Code from Point
Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14042). They are shared under the source's
[Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International licence](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/).
The [pinned source card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/filapro/cad-recode/blob/17d554bbc50a23de6cf6a742a3e0ed867f000153/README.md)
states `license: cc-by-nc-4.0`. These derived artefacts retain that restriction;
the library's code licence does not replace it.


## The table

`fidelity.json.gz` is the `FidelityTable` of all 968 programs under `cq` (arris
0.10.0) against the oracle (CadQuery 2.3.0,
`cadquery-ocp` 7.9.3.0), no verdicts applied; `oracle.jsonl.gz` the oracle's rows
(STEP text and wall-clock time left out); `arris-report.json` / `.md` the arris
report; `reach-report.json` the `ReachReport` under today's `cq` subset. Written by
`uv run --extra corpus tools/cq_corpus.py --corpus cadrecode` (network, the oracle environment; outside the gate), which saves
its work in chunks and resumes. No program text is committed. Each figure is
over all 968 programs. Re-run by plans/in-subset-cq-bugs step 10
(2026-11-13), after both workers read `r` (ADR-0015) and `origin=`,
`workplane(offset=…)`, `box` on a `moveTo` point and a compound result
(ADR-0016) were lifted.

- Reach: 37/968 in-subset (the curve's item 3; C1's subset reaches 0).
- Agreement: 37 agree; outcomes {'agree': 37, 'disagree': 931, 'unclassified': 0}.
- Classes: {'arris_bug': 0, 'arris_refusal': 0, 'by_design': 0, 'cq_bug': 931, 'occt_wrong': 0}.
- Arris statuses: {'arris_refusal': 0, 'checker_fail': 0, 'crash': 0, 'ok': 37, 'runtime': 0, 'syntax': 0, 'timeout': 0, 'unsupported_api': 931}.
- Oracle statuses: {'crash': 0, 'invalid': 0, 'no_result': 0, 'ok': 968, 'runtime': 0, 'syntax': 0, 'timeout': 0}.
- Timeouts: 0.
- In-subset: outcomes {'agree': 37, 'disagree': 0, 'unclassified': 0}, classes {'arris_bug': 0, 'arris_refusal': 0, 'by_design': 0, 'cq_bug': 0, 'occt_wrong': 0};
  `in_subset_cq_bug` 0, `in_subset_by_design` 0.

Table digest: `2aa87494c795c2321de08d8bee2d5effa8ba426c5fe50067eca163b70ce588f4`. Oracle rows SHA-256 (uncompressed): `8d28ce1199f0b98f0878bdd63789fcfed2ee2e2648178b9a7289b17f2c1f195f`.

Every agreement is two `ok` builds: the oracle now builds all 968 programs,
and the 931 `cq_bug` rows are `unsupported_api` on forms outside the subset
(`cylinder`, `sketch()` and its calls, the curve's items 4 to 18). Five of the
37 are unions of disjoint boxes that both sides build as a compound (ADR-0016).

The baseline (plans/fidelity-target step 6, table digest
`7f19ee794233d27fc3c0d7f0a5f885ae3e5ea65d37bb00fef28a8f95408ea440`) had
reach 0 and 968 vacuous agreements: neither worker read `r = …` as a result
(`unsupported_api` against `no_result`), so every oracle row changed with
ADR-0015, as intended.

## Verdicts

`verdicts.json` holds the verdict of the one row no rule classes: stem `550`, two crossing cylinders, `occt_wrong` by its closed form (`tools/cq_closed_forms.py`, `--corpus cadrecode`): arris is within 1e-11 of it on volume, area and centroid, and Open CASCADE's volume is 2.6e-9 off, past ADR-0005's 1e-9. The table is run with `--verdicts tests/fixtures/c2/cadrecode/verdicts.json`.
